title: Capability matrix
action: List the products, environments, and data types in scope.
pass_criteria: The capability matrix lists products, environments, and supported data types.

title: Venue constraints
action: Record venue restrictions, unsupported capabilities, and testnet differences.
pass_criteria: Venue limits, unsupported capabilities, and environment differences are documented.

title: Protocol boundaries
action: Identify separate product APIs, public and private endpoints, and binary or JSON transports.
pass_criteria: Each supported product identifies its endpoints, transport, and wire format.

title: Initial slice
action: Choose the smallest slice that proves an end-to-end path.
pass_criteria: The test plan identifies one instrument and public stream that exercise the complete data path.

title: Repository wiring
action: Add the crate to the Rust workspace and test inventory, then add only the projection surfaces it exposes.
pass_criteria: The workspace and test inventory discover the crate and each supported projection.

title: Define scope exit
action: Check the applicable phase outcomes.
pass_criteria: The integration guide contains the initial capability matrix, known gaps, and test plan.

title: HTTP error types
action: Model transport, HTTP status, venue, parsing, and validation failures. Classify retryability when supported.
pass_criteria: Tests distinguish transport, HTTP, venue, parse, and validation errors and verify applicable retry classification.
skip_when: The connector uses no HTTP transport.

title: HTTP client
action: Implement endpoint resolution and typed requests, plus credentials, signing, rate limits, retries, and pagination as needed.
pass_criteria: Mock peers verify the exact typed requests, endpoints, and applicable authentication, pagination, and retry behavior.
skip_when: The connector uses no HTTP transport.

title: HTTP API models
action: Define typed requests and responses, commonly under `http/` or its product-specific modules.
pass_criteria: Typed request and response models cover valid captured or documented payloads.
skip_when: The connector uses no HTTP transport.

title: HTTP parsing
action: Convert venue responses to domain types at deterministic boundaries in `http/parse.rs` or `common/parse.rs`.
pass_criteria: Fixture tests produce exact domain values at a parser boundary without network access.
skip_when: The connector uses no HTTP transport.

title: WebSocket error types
action: Model connection, protocol, and parsing failures, plus authentication and command failures when applicable.
pass_criteria: The WebSocket boundary distinguishes connection, protocol, parse, and applicable auth or command errors.
skip_when: The connector uses no WebSocket transport.

title: WebSocket client
action: Implement lifecycle and shutdown, plus authentication, heartbeat, subscription state, and reconnection when applicable.
pass_criteria: Mock peers demonstrate connection, heartbeat, subscription handling, reconnect, and clean shutdown.
skip_when: The connector uses no WebSocket transport.

title: WebSocket messages
action: Define frames and messages under `websocket/` or product-specific modules. Include acknowledgements and venue errors as needed.
pass_criteria: Typed fixtures cover supported data, acknowledgements, and venue errors.
skip_when: The connector uses no WebSocket transport.

title: WebSocket parsing
action: Decode each frame once, construct domain events, and route by typed identity.
pass_criteria: Frames are decoded once and routed as complete domain events with the correct typed identity.
skip_when: The connector uses no WebSocket transport.

title: Protocol tests
action: Prove fixtures, canonical requests, applicable signing vectors, lifecycle, and raw exchanges with mock peers.
pass_criteria: Canonical wire fixtures and mock exchanges pass, including applicable signing and lifecycle cases.

title: Build the protocol core exit
action: Check the applicable phase outcomes.
pass_criteria: The crate compiles, canonical fixtures parse, and mock or controlled peers complete applicable authentication and wire exchanges.

title: Instrument parsing
action: Parse every supported family with complete identity, precision, currency, and contract fields.
pass_criteria: One or more distinct fixtures cover each supported family, with exact identity, currency, precision, and contract fields. Invalid definitions fail clearly.

title: Instrument loading
action: Load, filter, cache, and emit definitions at each parsing boundary that needs context.
pass_criteria: Required definitions reach the parsing context and engine with the correct filters and cache updates.

title: Symbol mapping
action: Define bidirectional venue symbol and `InstrumentId` conversion without collapsing distinct instruments.
pass_criteria: Venue symbol and InstrumentId round trips preserve identity across supported product families.

title: Instrument updates
action: Implement fresh instrument requests and any supported definition or status updates.
pass_criteria: Explicit requests observe provider updates and supported definition or status transitions reach the engine.

title: Implement instruments exit
action: Check the applicable phase outcomes.
pass_criteria: Distinct fixtures cover each supported family, invalid definitions fail clearly, and the client emits or returns complete instruments.

title: Public WebSocket streams
action: Subscribe and unsubscribe each advertised live data type while preserving subscription intent.
pass_criteria: Every advertised stream subscribes, delivers its data, and stops after settled unsubscribe. Reconnect restores active intent.
skip_when: The connector uses no WebSocket transport.

title: Historical data requests
action: Request supported bars, trades, quotes, or order book snapshots with exact correlation and freshness rules.
pass_criteria: Responses contain the requested instrument and filters, retain correlation and parameters, and respect the freshness contract.
skip_when: The connector offers no historical data or book snapshot requests.

title: Data client
action: Implement `DataClient` requests, subscriptions, lifecycle, and complete `DataEvent` emission.
pass_criteria: The supported request and subscription matrix emits complete typed DataEvent values through the normal lifecycle.

title: Order book handling
action: Preserve snapshot, incremental update, sequence, clear, and batch boundaries.
pass_criteria: Book output preserves the venue sequence policy, snapshot and clear semantics, and logical event boundaries.
skip_when: The connector offers no order book data.

title: Stream recovery
action: Handle malformed input, gaps, unsubscribe, disconnect, reconnect, and subscription replay.
pass_criteria: Recovery tests cover malformed frames, stream gaps, unsubscribe, disconnect, and replay of active subscriptions.
skip_when: The connector offers no live streams.

title: Implement market data exit
action: Check the applicable phase outcomes.
pass_criteria: Unit tests and mock transports prove complete domain events across the supported request and subscription matrix.

title: Venue-specific data
action: Add funding, greeks, liquidations, or venue extensions as separate capability slices.
pass_criteria: Every advertised extension has its own event contract and test coverage.
skip_when: The connector has no optional venue capabilities in scope.

title: Product or endpoint splits
action: Split ownership only when protocol, authentication, quota, or recovery boundaries require it.
pass_criteria: Changes to session or product ownership follow a documented protocol, authentication, quota, or recovery boundary.
skip_when: The connector has no product or endpoint splits in scope.

title: Capability proof
action: Add fixtures, functional tests, acceptance cases, and documented limitations for each capability.
pass_criteria: Each enabled capability has fixtures, functional and acceptance evidence, and documented limitations.
skip_when: The connector has no optional venue capabilities in scope.

title: Add optional venue capabilities exit
action: Check the applicable phase outcomes.
pass_criteria: Each optional capability is independently testable and preserves the established base paths.
skip_when: The connector has no optional venue capabilities in scope.

title: Configuration structs
action: Finalize typed data client configs, defaults, environment fallback, and secret redaction.
pass_criteria: Typed configs expose defaults and applicable environment fallback. Secret values are redacted.

title: Client factories
action: Implement Rust factories with `CacheView` inputs and the data client clock.
pass_criteria: The configured factory constructs a working data client with the required clock and CacheView input.

title: PyO3 registration
action: Register applicable factories and config extractors with the PyO3 registry.
pass_criteria: Applicable factories and config extractors resolve through the PyO3 registry.
skip_when: The connector exposes no Python projection.

title: Python package
action: Add the public package and Python boundary tests for the capabilities exposed to Python.
pass_criteria: Public Python imports and exposed capabilities pass Python boundary tests.
skip_when: The connector exposes no Python projection.

title: Generated stubs
action: Add Rust stub metadata and regenerate the `.pyi` output with `make py-stubs`.
pass_criteria: Regenerated Python stubs match the Rust metadata.
skip_when: The connector exposes no Python projection.

title: Complete factories and projection exit
action: Check the applicable phase outcomes.
pass_criteria: Rust factory tests pass. Where Python is exposed, boundary tests pass, imports resolve, and generated output matches Rust inputs.

title: Rust unit tests
action: Prove parsers, serializers, symbols, signatures, state transitions, and malformed input.
pass_criteria: Focused tests cover valid and malformed inputs and the relevant state transitions.

title: Rust integration tests
action: Exercise the public HTTP, WebSocket, and data boundaries against deterministic mock transports.
pass_criteria: Deterministic mock tests assert exact venue requests and resulting Nautilus events.

title: Python boundary tests
action: Prove imports, config extraction, factories, type conversion, and representative async calls.
pass_criteria: Feature-gated Python tests cover imports, config extraction, factories, conversion, and representative async calls.
skip_when: The connector exposes no Python projection.

title: Acceptance tests
action: Run every applicable data acceptance case on a supported venue environment. Use a controlled account when authentication is required.
pass_criteria: Applicable data cases have venue evidence, including expected events and venue state.

title: Recovery tests
action: Exercise connection failure, reconnect, shutdown, rate limits, and state recovery.
pass_criteria: Controlled failures prove reconnect, shutdown, rate-limit, and state-recovery behavior.

title: Specification gaps
action: Record every skipped specification case with a venue or capability reason.
pass_criteria: Each skipped case names the venue or capability reason for its omission.

title: Prove conformance exit
action: Check the applicable phase outcomes.
pass_criteria: The applicable data testing cases pass and each advertised capability has deterministic and venue evidence.

title: Canonical benchmarks
action: Measure confirmed end-to-end market-data hot paths with representative fixtures.
pass_criteria: End-to-end benchmarks use representative raw payloads and measure the production data path.

title: Microbenchmarks
action: Isolate confirmed signing, hashing, authentication, codec, parsing, or serialization costs.
pass_criteria: Measurements localize a confirmed hot-path cost at its component boundary.
skip_when: Measurements identify no component requiring a focused microbenchmark.

title: Fuzz targets
action: Fuzz untrusted parsing, decoding, normalization, signing, and encoding boundaries with realistic corpora.
pass_criteria: Applicable untrusted input paths run against realistic fuzz corpora.

title: Invariants
action: Assert domain and protocol properties stronger than panic freedom.
pass_criteria: Fuzz assertions check protocol and domain invariants in addition to panic freedom.

title: Measure performance and robustness exit
action: Check the applicable phase outcomes.
pass_criteria: Benchmark and fuzz suites cover representative fixtures and documented invariants for the capabilities in use.

title: Capability matrix
action: Reconcile every support claim and exception with the tested implementation.
pass_criteria: Every advertised capability and exception maps to tested behavior.

title: Integration guide
action: Document configuration, applicable credentials, limits, environment differences, and known gaps.
pass_criteria: The integration guide describes configuration, applicable credentials, limits, environment differences, and known gaps.

title: Tester entry points
action: Provide applicable Rust and Python data tester entry points with safe defaults.
pass_criteria: Each applicable Rust or Python data tester has a documented, safe entry point.

title: Operations
action: Document recovery, troubleshooting, and any venue behavior an operator must understand.
pass_criteria: Operators can find venue recovery behavior and troubleshooting steps.

title: Final verification
action: Verify links, generated output, examples, and the focused documentation checks.
pass_criteria: Links, examples, generated output, and focused documentation checks pass as applicable.

title: Finish documentation and operations exit
action: Check the applicable phase outcomes.
pass_criteria: A user can configure, test, operate, and diagnose the connector from the documentation.

title: Client start
action: Verify `start` in a lifecycle test. Install local event plumbing and start client-owned background work.
pass_criteria: Local event paths exist before any task can publish.

title: Client connect
action: Verify `connect` in a lifecycle test. Establish transports, authenticate, load required definitions or account state, and start stream processing.
pass_criteria: Public commands can use the transport, and required bootstrap state is observable.

title: Client disconnect
action: Verify `disconnect` in a lifecycle test. Stop new network work and close transports.
pass_criteria: The client no longer sends or receives venue traffic.

title: Client stop
action: Verify `stop` in a lifecycle test. End client-owned work using an idempotent path.
pass_criteria: Repeated teardown is safe.

title: Client reset
action: Verify `reset` in a lifecycle test. Clear reconnectable caches, counters, cancellation state, and stale in-flight state.
pass_criteria: A later start or connection does not inherit invalid session state.

title: Client dispose
action: Verify `dispose` in a lifecycle test. Release background tasks, threads, and external handles.
pass_criteria: No client-owned resource remains active.

title: Connected readiness and failed bootstrap
action: Drive startup through a controlled venue. Observe engine instrument state and command readiness, then inject a failure after resources start.
pass_criteria: The required engine state and active protocol path are ready before connected is reported. Failed startup cleans up resources and leaves the client retryable.

title: Fresh instrument requests
action: Change the provider response between two explicit instrument requests. Exercise both single and list requests when exposed.
pass_criteria: The second response reflects the changed provider state. Cache results are allowed where the API contract explicitly permits them.

title: Response identity and correlation
action: Submit requests with explicit IDs, filters, and parameters. Observe typed response events.
pass_criteria: Responses match the requested identity and filters and preserve the original correlation ID and parameters.

title: Typed event dispatch
action: Inspect event construction and exercise valid payloads, malformed input, and a closed downstream receiver.
pass_criteria: Only complete validated events reach the engine. Dispatch holds no mutable adapter state. A closed receiver is logged and handled by teardown.

title: Polled instrument status transitions
action: Replay full inventory snapshots with unchanged, changed, and removed instruments, including subscription filtering.
pass_criteria: Only meaningful changes are emitted. Removals follow venue semantics. The full private cache is updated even when emissions are filtered.
skip_when: The connector does not derive instrument status from polled snapshots.

title: Unix nanosecond timestamps
action: Check ts_event and ts_init for every supported timestamped type and history response, using DataTester warnings where supported.
pass_criteria: Both timestamps use Unix nanoseconds. Live event time is near the session clock and ts_init reflects local object creation. No scale warning is emitted.

title: WebSocket protocol recovery
action: Force a reconnect with active subscriptions and exercise applicable control and venue heartbeat traffic.
pass_criteria: The active command path, authentication if needed, instrument context, and subscription intent are restored. Sequence-sensitive streams rebootstrap where required.
skip_when: The connector uses no WebSocket transport.

title: Live event delivery and consumer shutdown
action: Inspect queue policy and simulate a disconnected consumer in the normal live path.
pass_criteria: The live path preserves unbounded Tokio channels and surfaces handler failure. A bounded queue, coalescing, dropping, or disconnect-on-full requires an explicit shared design.
skip_when: The connector has no live event path.

title: Client task teardown
action: Interrupt an in-flight session operation with unsubscribe or shutdown and exercise repeated teardown.
pass_criteria: Owned tasks are signaled and joined or aborted within a bounded policy. Obsolete work stops and repeated teardown is safe.
skip_when: The connector owns no background or asynchronous work.

title: Deterministic fixtures
action: Review canonical fixtures and run the ordinary unit and integration suite against fixtures or controlled peers.
pass_criteria: Valid fixtures under test_data come from venue docs or captures. Synthetic negative fixtures are identified and ordinary tests require no live venue access.

title: Public boundary and adverse protocol tests
action: Drive supported requests and streams through mock peers, including multiple symbols where supported, malformed frames, stale acknowledgements, and reconnect.
pass_criteria: Tests assert exact venue requests and complete typed events. Later valid data survives malformed input and retired subscriptions receive no further data.

title: Book stream contract
action: Apply emitted OrderBookDeltas batches to the upstream BookStreamChecker and enable sequence checks where the venue is monotonic within a snapshot episode.
pass_criteria: Every logical group ends with F_LAST and passes the book integrity check. A snapshot is Clear then zero or more Adds with F_SNAPSHOT. Incrementals follow a snapshot without Clear or F_SNAPSHOT and advance sequence where applicable. Unsubscribed books are quiet after settling.
skip_when: The connector emits no order book deltas.

title: Per-book recovery ownership
action: Exercise repeated gaps, monitored deadlines, refused tasks, and unsubscribe while a recovery claim is pending.
pass_criteria: An unsynced book has one active recovery owner, a monitored snapshot deadline, or a path to request recovery again. Refused tasks release ownership and removal cancels obsolete work.
skip_when: The connector does not maintain books from a venue stream.

title: Replacement snapshot acceptance
action: Test the venue recovery family with stale, empty, and authoritative snapshots. For pull recovery, validate the retained diff bridge. For push recovery, verify replacement ownership and the snapshot gate.
pass_criteria: Only a snapshot valid for the current recovery replaces the complete book. Empty snapshots clear it. A successful subscription write alone never establishes a usable book.
skip_when: The connector does not maintain books from a venue stream.

title: Independent venue oracle
action: Build an independent oracle from a separate connection or REST snapshot and call BookStreamChecker::verify at aligned venue positions.
pass_criteria: Compared states agree. Unaligned samples do not count toward a pass. Report episode coverage or matched and unmatched samples according to the harness.
skip_when: The connector emits no order book deltas.

title: Model
action: Property test of the per-book state machine against a reference model, plus planted regressions
pass_criteria: The property test passes, and reverting a known fix, such as the gap ownership rule, makes it fail
skip_when: The change is below L0 in the upstream validation table.
trigger: Any change to `BookSync`, `BookRecovery`, or an adapter's use of them

title: Conformance
action: Rerun the venue's stress harness or established oracle
pass_criteria: PASS at the documented bar, zero checker violations, zero dark books, zero unexplained errors
skip_when: The change is below L1 in the upstream validation table.
trigger: Any change to previously validated sync/recovery code

title: Edge probe
action: Targeted boundary scenarios, including each new tuning extreme
pass_criteria: Every scenario passes. Disabled paths stay quiet. An exhausted budget reaches the ceiling and a late snapshot still restores the book
skip_when: The change is below L2 in the upstream validation table.
trigger: Boundary behavior changes (timeouts, disabled paths, budget exhaustion, the retry ceiling)

title: Race probe
action: Fault injection plus subscribe churn under an independent oracle
pass_criteria: Dozens of forced recoveries complete with zero dark books. The reported race scenario passes with no recurrence
skip_when: The change is below L3 in the upstream validation table.
trigger: Concurrency or ordering changes (gates, epochs, reconnect interplay), or any live-found race fix

title: Full validation
action: L1-L3 plus a sustained churn and reconnect-fault soak
pass_criteria: All lower bars hold for the full soak. Recovery latencies stay bounded
skip_when: The change is below L4 in the upstream validation table.

title: Sequence gap
action: Force a detectable sequence gap after the book is live.
pass_criteria: Output stops at the gap and resumes only after a fresh snapshot replaces the book.
skip_when: The connector does not maintain books from a venue stream.

title: Missing or late snapshot
action: Withhold the snapshot through its deadline, then deliver it between recovery attempts.
pass_criteria: The snapshot deadline starts or retries recovery. A snapshot accepted between attempts ends it.
skip_when: The connector does not maintain books from a venue stream.

title: Recovery cannot start
action: Make a replacement prerequisite unavailable or refuse the recovery task after it claims an episode.
pass_criteria: The book stays unowned and requests recovery again on its next frame. A refused task cancels its claimed episode.
skip_when: The connector does not maintain books from a venue stream.

title: Rejected replacement
action: Reject a replacement and exercise an error classified as permanent.
pass_criteria: Recovery retries. An error the classifier marks permanent skips the budget and retries at the ceiling.
skip_when: The connector does not maintain books from a venue stream.

title: Retry budget exhausted
action: Force recovery failures through the initial retry budget.
pass_criteria: One error log, then retries at the ceiling until a snapshot is accepted.
skip_when: The connector does not maintain books from a venue stream.

title: Reconnect mid-recovery
action: Reconnect while recovery is in flight and while retrying after its initial budget.
pass_criteria: The running recovery keeps its budget, ownership, and in-flight write, and its next ceiling wait ends at once. Other books resync from fresh snapshots.
skip_when: The connector does not maintain books from a venue stream.

title: Unsubscribe during recovery
action: Unsubscribe while recovery has a pending write.
pass_criteria: Recovery and its pending writes stop, and the book emits nothing further.
skip_when: The connector does not maintain books from a venue stream.

title: Request instruments
action: DataTester requests all instruments for the venue on start.
pass_criteria: At least one instrument received. Each has valid symbol, price precision, and size increment.

title: Subscribe instrument
action: DataTester subscribes to instrument updates.
pass_criteria: Instrument received with correct `instrument_id`, valid fields.
skip_when: Adapter does not support instrument subscriptions.

title: Load specific instrument
action: Load a specific instrument by `InstrumentId` via the instrument provider.
pass_criteria: Instrument loaded with correct ID, price precision, size increment, and trading rules.
event_sequence: Instrument available in cache after load.
notes: Exercise the provider directly and read the loaded instrument from the cache.

title: Subscribe book deltas
action: DataTester subscribes to order book deltas.
pass_criteria: Deltas received with valid instrument ID. At least one delta contains bid/ask updates.
skip_when: Adapter does not support order book data.

title: Subscribe book at interval
action: DataTester subscribes to periodic order book snapshots.
pass_criteria: Book snapshots received with bid/ask levels. Updates arrive at approximately the configured interval.
skip_when: Adapter does not support order book data.
event_sequence: `OrderBook` events received in `on_book` at configured interval.

title: Subscribe book depth
action: DataTester subscribes to `OrderBookDepth` snapshots.
pass_criteria: Depth snapshots respect the requested level limit. Prices are correctly ordered.
skip_when: Adapter does not support book depth subscriptions.

title: Request book snapshot
action: DataTester requests a one-time order book snapshot.
pass_criteria: Snapshot contains bid/ask levels with valid prices and sizes.
skip_when: Adapter does not support book snapshot requests.
event_sequence: Book snapshot received via historical data callback.

title: Managed book from deltas
action: DataTester subscribes to deltas with `manage_book=True`. Builds local order book from the delta stream.
pass_criteria: Local book builds correctly from deltas. Bid levels descend, ask levels ascend. Book is not empty after initial snapshot.
skip_when: Adapter does not support order book data.
prerequisite: Adapter connected, instrument loaded, book deltas streaming.
event_sequence: `OrderBookDeltas` applied to local `OrderBook`. Book logged with configured depth.
notes: Use a custom actor to exercise historical book deltas when exposed. RC9 DataTester does not issue that request.

title: Subscribe quotes
action: DataTester subscribes to quotes on start.
pass_criteria: At least one `QuoteTick` received with valid bid/ask prices and sizes. Bid < ask.

title: Request historical quotes
action: DataTester requests historical quote ticks.
pass_criteria: Quotes received with valid timestamps, bid/ask prices, and sizes.
skip_when: Adapter does not support historical quote requests.

title: Subscribe trades
action: DataTester subscribes to trades on start.
pass_criteria: At least one `TradeTick` received with valid price, size, and aggressor side.

title: Request historical trades
action: DataTester requests historical trade ticks.
pass_criteria: Trades received with valid timestamps, prices, sizes, and trade IDs.
skip_when: Adapter does not support historical trade requests.

title: Subscribe bars
action: DataTester subscribes to bars for a configured `BarType`.
pass_criteria: At least one `Bar` received with valid OHLCV values. High >= low, high >= open, high >= close.
skip_when: Adapter does not support bar subscriptions.
prerequisite: Adapter connected, instrument loaded, bar type configured.

title: Request historical bars
action: DataTester requests historical bars for a configured `BarType`.
pass_criteria: Bars received with valid OHLCV values and ascending timestamps.
skip_when: Adapter does not support historical bar requests.
prerequisite: Adapter connected, instrument loaded, bar type configured.

title: Subscribe mark prices
action: DataTester subscribes to mark price updates.
pass_criteria: At least one `MarkPriceUpdate` received with valid instrument ID and mark price.
skip_when: Instrument is not a derivative, or adapter does not provide mark prices.

title: Subscribe index prices
action: DataTester subscribes to index price updates.
pass_criteria: At least one `IndexPriceUpdate` received with valid instrument ID and index price.
skip_when: Instrument is not a derivative, or adapter does not provide index prices.

title: Subscribe funding rates
action: DataTester subscribes to funding rate updates.
pass_criteria: At least one `FundingRateUpdate` received with valid instrument ID and rate.
skip_when: Instrument is not a perpetual, or adapter does not provide funding rates.

title: Request historical funding rates
action: DataTester requests historical funding rates (default 7-day lookback).
pass_criteria: Funding rates received with valid timestamps and rate values.
skip_when: Instrument is not a perpetual, or adapter does not support historical funding rate requests.
event_sequence: Historical funding rates received via callback.

title: Subscribe instrument status
action: DataTester subscribes to instrument status updates.
pass_criteria: Status events received with valid `MarketStatusAction` (e.g. `Trading`).
skip_when: Adapter does not support instrument status subscriptions.

title: Subscribe instrument close
action: DataTester subscribes to instrument close events.
pass_criteria: Close event received with valid close price and close type.
skip_when: Adapter does not support instrument close subscriptions.

title: Subscribe option greeks
action: DataTester subscribes to option greeks updates.
pass_criteria: Greeks received with valid delta, gamma, vega, theta values.
skip_when: Adapter does not support option greeks subscriptions.

title: Subscribe option chain
action: DataTester subscribes to option chain snapshots for a series.
pass_criteria: Chain snapshot contains greeks for instruments matching the series.
skip_when: Adapter does not support option chain subscriptions.
prerequisite: Adapter connected, option instruments loaded for the series.
notes: Use a manual actor with subscribe_option_chain and an OptionSeriesId.

title: Unsubscribe on stop
action: Stop the actor with `can_unsubscribe=True` (default).
pass_criteria: Clean unsubscribe. No errors in logs. No data events after stop.
skip_when: Adapter does not support unsubscribe.
event_sequence: Data subscriptions removed. No further data events received.

title: Custom subscribe params
action: Subscribe with adapter-specific `subscribe_params`.
pass_criteria: Data flows with adapter-specific parameters in effect.
skip_when: The connector exposes no custom subscription parameters.
prerequisite: Adapter connected, adapter accepts additional subscription parameters.
event_sequence: Subscription established with custom parameters applied.
notes: Configure subscribe_params in the Rust tester.

title: Custom request params
action: Request data with adapter-specific `request_params`.
pass_criteria: Historical data received with adapter-specific parameters in effect.
skip_when: The connector exposes no custom request parameters.
prerequisite: Adapter connected, adapter accepts additional request parameters.
event_sequence: Request fulfilled with custom parameters applied.
notes: Configure request_params in the Rust tester.

title: Retirement cleanup
action: Retire the first actor, then retire the second actor through the trader.
pass_criteria: The first retirement keeps shared data active. The final retirement releases the retained route and leaves no retired actor handlers.
prerequisite: An actor has venue-backed subscriptions. Two actors share an internally aggregated bar.
event_sequence: `on_dispose` completes. Unsubscribe commands are sent. The actor is deregistered.
notes: Create two actors that share the route and retire them through Trader or Controller. Exercise failed on_dispose, on_stop, and on_fault per the spec.

title: DeFi shared pool demand
action: Retire or unsubscribe one actor, then the other, in each order.
pass_criteria: Pool events keep reaching the remaining actor and the profiler until the final release. None flow afterwards.
skip_when: Adapter does not provide DeFi pool subscriptions.
prerequisite: A DeFi data client. Two actors subscribe to the same pool, through the same or overlapping subscription types.
event_sequence: The first release sends no client unsubscribe for shared types. The final release unsubscribes and stops the pool updater.
notes: Use manual actors. Cover same-type demand, broad and narrow overlap, both release orders, duplicate unsubscribe, and two data clients.

title: DeFi bootstrap cancel
action: Subscribe, release the final owner before the pool definition arrives, then subscribe again.
pass_criteria: The engine discards the first response. Only the response to the current request installs a profiler.
skip_when: Adapter does not provide pool snapshots.
prerequisite: A DeFi data client. The pool is absent from the cache, so a subscription requests a pool snapshot.
event_sequence: Two snapshot requests are sent. The response to the first arrives after the second subscription.
notes: Hold the first snapshot while the pool is absent from the cache. Verify that reset or disconnect also invalidates a pending bootstrap.
